text:
Aisha: ACME pilot ask summary: per-route efficiency hints (batch/cache/quant) + eval-triggered alerts. Need scoped MVP for 2 sprints.

Noah: Suggestion: target the Console route detail page + a small webhook for alerts. Keep quant as recommend-only.

Rina: UX: inline compact banner with [Preview] [Copy config]. No autosave. Keep explanations short: latency vs cost tradeoff.

Sam: Ops constraints: per-route feature flag, sampled telemetry (0.5-1%), audit logs, and a cost-safety check when suggestions would raise token expense >10%.

Aisha: Launch must-haves: visible hints on pilot routes, Preview/Copy flow, eval-alert wired to pilot Slack webhook, opt-out flag, docs.

Noah: Quick config snippet for copy:
```yaml
route_tuning:
  batch_hint: 6
  kv_cache: true
  quant: recommend-int8
  source: tune-v0.1
```

Rina: Acceptance metrics: suggestions show for >=85% sampled routes; p99 latency impact <12%; eval-alert FP <6% during pilot.

ops-bot: Created ticket RW-6999 -> owner Sam.

Sam: Estimate: spike 3d (1 eng) + MVP 2 sprints (2 engs + 0.5 infra). Need runbook for alert fatigue.

Aisha: OK locking scope: per-route read-only recommendations, sampled eval-alerts for 1 metric, pilot opt-in. I'll write a short PRD and loop in CS for onboarding.
